name: Crowded-attention LEVEL fade — short at the top of the range (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: same exhaustion thesis — a sustained elevated social_attention_z LEVEL means the crowd is all-in and forward return skews negative — but this variant confirms the blow-off with range_position (price near the top of its recent range) instead of RSI, a DIFFERENT over-extension gauge. Fading a loud crowd that has also pushed price to the range ceiling targets the euphoria peak. Counterparty is late buyers chasing the top. Real short funding/borrow costs must be cleared (funding leg wired). Exit when the crowd level normalizes.
catalyst: crowd-attention level extreme with price pinned at the range top
